name: oli
notes: Right arm, new tip site 18mm forward of right_pinch to place grip point between pads (fingers stuck out 18.4mm). Approach +x palm-to-tip, closing +y travel 38mm Y vs 6.4 X. Prior run 7/10 ok (3/5 cube, 4/5 block) with IK ~1mm but disqualified for hip_yaw_links touching table at base -0.25. Moved base back to -0.30 to keep hips/feet behind table back edge x=-0.20 while preserving reach (was 0.502m). Kept waist in active and orientation 1.0. Unsure exact pad z, used -0.016. Uses LimX's own parallel gripper (scripts/limx_gripper.py builds HU_D04_01_gripper.xml from their gripper URDF); the earlier Robotiq version is in outputs/adapters/oli/oli_robotiq.json. gripper_closed set to 0.7, where LimX's fingertips meet (Muse used the joint limit 1.0, past the contact point).
